description:
Get per-post insights for one media object.

The valid metric set depends on the media type, so pass media_product_type and the right defaults are used: FEED for posts and carousels, REELS for reels, STORY for stories. Carousel albums report only whole-post figures — Meta serves no per-child insights.

Example: "how did the latest reel do" -> media_id from instagram_list_media, media_product_type="REELS"

media_id.description: Media ID to read insights for

media_product_type.description: Which metric set to request. Check the media's media_product_type with instagram_get_media.

metrics.description: Override the default metric set for this media type. See instagram_list_metric_catalog.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: instagram_get_media_insights
title: Get Media Insights
